{{Nihongo|Mimi|ミーメ|Mīme}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]].''

Mimi works at the local circus with her husband [[Barney (DS)|Barney]]. Her husband works as the ring master, and Mimi herself is an acrobat. Although her and her husband run the circus, they don't have any other staff members to help them with their business.

Mimi and Barney will not come to town until after your child is born. The circus grounds are located next to the spring in the south eastern part of town. You can talk to and befriend both Mimi and Barney, but the circus itself will never actually open.

The couple spend most of their time in the circus tent, but leave on Tuesdays.
